collection.runtime: CPU Torch 2.1.0+cu121, frame skip 4, 50 raw warmup noops, original max 2000 decisions

closed_loop_protocol.interventions: Full steering/throttle/brake Oracle feedback for fixed 12 or 25 decisions, then original RLPD actor recomputed at every branch observation to real episode end.
closed_loop_protocol.local_guards: Alive at assessment, abs lateral error <=6m, progress gain>=0.02, no added damage from anchor through assessment.
closed_loop_protocol.policy_at_anchor: Current-runtime executed prefix and accessible simulator/observation parity; historical archive divergence not repaired.

training_dataset.accepted_window: Only locally qualified paired full-finish rescues or preserved finishes; actual intervention plus first 63 actor handoff decisions, retaining original action roles and raw rewards.

first_learning_treatment.preflight: passed: 15915 ordinary prior rows plus 665 recovery rows, zero resets
first_learning_treatment.source: V5 seed50 final model/target critic/temperature/three optimizers, fresh online replay and reset RNG seed60; not exact historical continuation
first_learning_treatment.objective: Unchanged raw-reward SAC; no behavior cloning

contemporary_evaluation.prospective_curve_failure_endpoint: Genuine crash/off-track/out-of-bounds within 63 decisions of overspeed, with sustained lane loss or added damage; temporal association, not causal proof.
contemporary_evaluation.failed_attempt_reason: Endpoint helper used retire_reason instead of the shared collector summary reason field; stopped after one completed receipt and the next saved trace, then corrected and tested in a new output directory.
contemporary_evaluation.decision: Reject data-only Q-learning intervention: no completion or prospective curve-terminal improvement. Sparse curve-terminal proxy does not explain all 11 recovery failures.

next_intervention.objective: Unchanged raw SAC plus joint native deterministic-mean guidance only on 87 locally qualified, paired-finish-proven failure Oracle rows, and frozen-original-mean retention on ordinary prior plus recovery handoff/preserved-control rows.
next_intervention.mechanisms_are_hypotheses: One-step Q policy bootstrapping/sequence credit, representation drift and changed state visitation are alternatives; Q rankings are not causal proof or expert-optimality guarantees.

third_intervention.objective: Original encoder/critics/temperature fixed bitwise; only actor decoder joint native correction on proven failure-Oracle rows, with original-mean retention on verified ordinary prior, all original initial images and source-finished path snapshots.
third_intervention.mechanism_hypothesis: Isolate successful local action correction from raw-SAC representation/behavior drift and explicitly protect initial/successful visual states; closed-loop performance still required.

interpretation: Full-vector feedback can actually rescue specific visited failures, but unconditional recovery also harms finished-parent controls.
Five-second safety alone is not proof of rescue because unchanged baselines can pass it and fail later.
The retained positive windows are privileged training-data upper bounds, not a deployable branch selector.
Branch menu repeats and two actors on some geometries are correlated; denominators are actor-road anchors, not independent roads.
The first data-only learner worsened finish rate and lost all five original finishes; a proven recovery dataset is not proof that replay alone learns a safe visual recovery policy.
No learned improvement, fresh-road performance, official submission or model promotion exists yet.
